parameters.counting_rule: Applies only to hatchery (adipose-fin-clipped) trout or steelhead; combined daily bag of 2, combined possession limit of 4.

parameters.note: Only hatchery trout or steelhead showing a healed adipose fin clip may be retained; wild (unclipped) trout or steelhead must be released immediately.

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Battle Creek South Fork (Tehama Co.) — the Reach B / South Fork portion above the Coleman National Fish Hatchery weir — for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of March-July & September-October (this entry covers the March-July window). Plans are provisional; execution is not guaranteed.
